hero.title: Make your stream
hero.copy: The Road to Somewhere builds tools and visual experiences for streamers who want to provide visual responses to events that happen on their streams, and content to engage their viewers.

extensions.title: Streamer.bot Extensions
extensions.text: Built to be installed easily, configured clearly, and seen on stream. All RTS extensions are FFN - Free For Now.

shared.title: Shared components for the extension family.
shared.text: Core components used by The Road to Somewhere extensions.

other-tools.title: Tools for your streaming setup.
other-tools.text: Useful tools for OBS and the wider streaming workflow.

about.title: Tools and Widgets with a purpose.
paragraphs: The Road to Somewhere is a collection of tools designed to help you **REACT** to **EVENTS** and **INTERACTIONS** from your **AUDIENCE** and streaming **PLATFORMS** to help make your stream more **ENGAGING**.
Each project is designed as a complete experience: polished visuals, useful configuration, clear documentation, and sensible installation.

support.title: Keep the journey moving.
support.text: RTS extensions are FFN - Free For Now. If you use the extensions a lot, enjoy having them on your stream, or simply want to support the time and work that goes into building and maintaining them, donations are always appreciated. There is never any obligation to donate - using and enjoying the extensions is already appreciated.
